_comment: Copy to <work>/spec.json and fill from the reference images BEFORE modeling. Remove keys starting with _ if you like (they are ignored).
name: Example pistol
_collection: optional: only verify objects inside this collection (e.g. 'Model'); null = whole scene
_dimensions: overall bounding box [X width, Y depth, Z height] in meters, measured from the orthographic refs
_contact_tolerance: max gap (m) that still counts as touching for the floating-part check; null = 0.2% of model size

parts.name: Slide
parts.notes: serrations at the rear: 9 grooves each side

_parts: every visible piece. 'pattern' is an fnmatch glob on object names; 'count' = number of matching objects (or set count_islands: true to count mesh islands inside one object). 'color' is checked against untextured materials.

allowed_intersections.reason: screw shanks sunk into panels, hidden

_intentionally_separate: object name globs allowed to float apart from the main body (e.g. a detached magazine shown next to the gun)

weapon._grip_point: an Empty placed at the centre of the hand position, oriented with the weapon

_weapon: set to null for non-hand-held objects
